Filtering DNS · tap for the log

Tunnel runs a local VPN on this phone so that DNS lookups (the names of sites and services apps connect to) go through Jaruri.

• Blocked names get no answer; everything else is looked up through your current network's DNS, as before.
• Jaruri keeps a log of lookups (time, app when Android says which, name, allowed/blocked) on this phone only, for 7 days (daily counts for 90 days). It is never backed up or uploaded.
• It can't see URLs, contents or passwords, and never decrypts anything.
• This build has the internet permission only to forward allowed lookups.
• Android allows one VPN at a time.

Best effort: blocks this app\'s DNS lookups when Android says which app asked (Android 10+, depends on the phone). An app can still connect using addresses it already has, a shared DNS cache, or its own encrypted DNS. Strict per-app blocking needs a later version.
